hero.title: Your Customers Reach Out. Connection Pilot Takes It From There.
hero.description: Connection Pilot helps businesses respond to customer inquiries, collect important information, and keep leads organized—all through one simple communication system.

stepOne.title: 1. A Customer Contacts Your Business
stepOne.description: Customers can contact your business by phone or text when they have a question, need a service, or want to request information.
stepOne.customerMessage: Hi, I need help with my air conditioner.

stepTwo.title: 2. Connection Pilot Responds
stepTwo.description: When a customer contacts your business, Connection Pilot can respond with a professional message and begin gathering the information your team needs.

messages.text: Hi! Sorry we missed your call. How can we help today?
We'd be happy to help. What's your name?

stepThree.title: 3. Important Details Are Captured
stepThree.description: Connection Pilot can collect the helpful details your team needs for a thoughtful follow-up.

stepFour.title: 4. Your Team Gets the Information
stepFour.description: Instead of searching through missed calls and text messages, your team sees the customer's information in an organized format so they can follow up.

stepFive.title: 5. Your Team Stays in Control
stepFive.description: Connection Pilot is designed to assist your team, not replace it. When a conversation needs a person, your business can step in and continue the conversation.
stepFive.controlNote: Your business remains in control of every customer relationship.
stepFive.humanText: A team member can join the conversation with the important details already in view.

cta.title: Less Time Chasing Messages. More Time Serving Customers.
cta.description: Connection Pilot helps turn customer communication into an organized, manageable process.
